title: 第05章 李元的天堂第06章 打破蛊师限制
slug: 南疆炼蛊三十载世人敬我如敬神
content_zh:
“那是自然。”
王邻道：“炼制本命尸蛊是门技术活，既要天赋，又要技艺，一般人做不到的。”
“我们十二洞，有谁炼了本命尸蛊吗？”
李元问道。
“没有。”
王邻摇头，“这是一项吃力不讨好的活，整个第九宫，都只有一位副宫主炼成了。”
“你不会想把你爷爷炼成本命尸蛊吧？”
“我还没那么变态。”
李元脸黑。
“谁知道呢？”
王邻笑道：“蛊师一脉变态可不少。”
他指了指后山。
“先去葬好你爷爷吧，那里是片风水好地，以后我死了，你也把我葬在那里。”
“你爷爷在这里人生地不熟的，我还能陪他说说话。”
“……”
李元无言。
还想当我爷的阴间版隔壁老王呢？
他背起太医尸体来到后山。
王邻跟了过来，“那口棺材看到了吗？是我给自已准备的，先给你爷爷用吧。”
“等以后我死了，你再给我打一副。”

“好。”
李元点头，“谢了老王。”
老王这人说话阴间了一点，但真能处，棺材本都拿出来了。
王邻笑道：“你也别把我当什么大善人，就是不想曝尸荒野，希望有个人帮我善后而已。”
闲聊间，李元挖出了一个大坑。
旋即来到棺木前，深吸一口气，猛地将棺材举起，放入坑中，再用土填埋起来。
顺带将老王还没刻字的墓碑也用了。
“太医爷爷，您走好。”
李元跪在墓碑前，重重磕了三个响头。
“您的仇，娘的仇，我一定会报！”
君子报仇，三十年不晚。
李元将那口恶气深埋在心底。
“力气不小啊，你的本命蛊是气血蛊吧？”
蛊师一脉身体素质远不如武者，一转蛊虫中能让蛊师气血充盈，力大如牛的最常见的就是气血蛊了。
王邻一下就猜到了。
“嗯。”
李元颔首。
content_en:
"That's natural."
Wang Lin said: "Refining the natal corpse Gu is a technical job that requires both talent and skills. Most people can't do it."
"Has anyone in our twelve caves refined the natal corpse Gu?"
Li Yuan asked.
"No."
Wang Lin shook his head, "This is a thankless job. The entire Ninth Palace was completed by only one deputy palace master."
"You don't want to make your grandfather into a corpse Gu, do you?"
"I'm not that perverted yet."
Li Yuan's face turned dark.
"Who knows?"
Wang Lin smiled and said: "There are quite a few perverts in the Gu Master lineage."
He pointed to the mountain behind.
"Go and bury your grandfather first. It's a land with good feng shui. When I die, you can bury me there too."
"Your grandpa is unfamiliar with the place here, so I can still talk to him."
"..."
Li Yuan was speechless.
Do you still want to be my father’s underworld version of the old king next door?
He carried the imperial doctor's body on his back and went to the back mountain.
Wang Lin followed, "Have you seen that coffin? I prepared it for myself. Give it to your grandpa first."
"When I die, you can give me another one."
"Okay."
Li Yuan nodded, "Thank you, Old Wang."
Lao Wang is a bit arrogant in his words, but he is really good at handling things and even took out the coffin.
Wang Lin smiled and said: "Don't think of me as a kind person. I just don't want my body to be exposed in the wilderness, and I hope someone can help me deal with the aftermath."
During the chat, Li Yuan dug a big hole.
Immediately he came to the coffin, took a deep breath, suddenly lifted the coffin, put it into the pit, and then filled it with soil.
By the way, Lao Wang's tombstone that had not yet been engraved was also used.
"Grandpa, the imperial doctor, please go away."
Li Yuan knelt in front of the tombstone and kowtowed three times.
"I will definitely avenge your revenge and my mother's revenge!"
Thirty years is not too late for a gentleman to take revenge.
Li Yuan buried the bad breath deep in his heart.
"You're quite powerful. Your natal Gu is Qi and Blood Gu, right?"
The physical quality of the Gu Master lineage is far inferior to that of the warriors. The most common Gu Master that can fill up the Gu Master's Qi and blood with one turn and become as strong as an ox is the Qi and Blood Gu.
Wang Lin guessed it right away.
"Yeah."
Li Yuan nodded.
